claim: The number one discipline hack: the cold shower, a game changer
Cold showers done every day, without missing one in probably four or five years, except maybe a day or two camping in hot weather without access
Cold showers bring physical benefits (immune system, other physiological ones) and an incredible emotional reset

Beyond the physical benefits and the emotional reset, personally the number one reason for sticking with cold showers seems to be that they keep one on track the most with discipline, because they always suck
With cold showers, the after is enjoyable, as is knowing how good it will be for the day; the first moment stepping in isn't ever really
Starting the day with a cold shower, at four, five or maybe nine after sleeping in, meant "boom", swimming downstream in the river of discipline, making other disciplined choices so much easier
A challenge: though other habits can have a big impact individually, find one more disastrous for your discipline than porn
A challenge: though other habits can have a big impact individually, find a two-minute one as positive for your discipline as cold showers
In coaching, many men, back to the first Bootcamp program years ago, have used cold showers in a foundation of habits to rebuild their discipline and stay away from porn
Porn and discipline work both ways: no porn eases disciplined choices, and disciplined choices ease staying off porn
Do not underestimate choices of maybe a couple of minutes, or 10, 15 or 20 minutes of porn: they can be disastrous for your discipline
Ejaculating has its own major energetic impact, of course
Beyond ejaculating, merely watching porn is basically going the opposite direction of discipline
Early in moving away from porn, or soon after, one of the most important things to do is rebuild your discipline, or build it even stronger
Needing to rebuild your discipline when moving away from porn is not that you have none: none of us is perfect, but we absolutely have ranges we can move in
